cases.verified_scope: Reports preserve independent source counts, paired completion/unresolved denominators and conditional-world uncertainty; zero observed deaths is never asserted to mean zero probability.

evidence.detail: Current student evaluation explicitly makes no confidence/significance claim.
Sixteen conditional worlds give about 20.59% marginal exact-binomial upper death endpoint at zero observed deaths; action copies cannot be pooled.

cases.unresolved_scope: Required source-battle/run-group confidence intervals for actual student win rate/HP and broad independent evaluation are not established. Conditional posterior-world intervals are not substitutes.
